nodes.label: Support Workspace UI Plan
nodes.rationale: Turn customer-support-ui into the Topic 06 workspace on the existing Python pipeline. Feature screens share typed API access. FastAPI services reuse the pipeline factory, graph, serializer, and PostgreSQL repository. Live data and illustrative preview data stay separate so the UI cannot invent a successful run.

nodes.label: Review API
nodes.rationale: Approval requires nonempty final text. Editing alone does not approve. Reassignment is its own review action. expected_updated_at and row locking reject stale concurrent edits. Human approval never sends a message, and API keys never reach the browser.

nodes.label: Live Batch API
nodes.rationale: POST /api/runs returns 202 and reuses the compiled graph, outcome_from_state, summarize, and save_outcomes. A finished batch with ticket failures is completed_with_errors. Empty agent_trace means no tool calls were recorded. Requests are capped at 500 tickets and 10 MB.

nodes.label: Awaiting Indexing
nodes.rationale: This slice stores PDF, Markdown, and text uploads with checksum deduplication and labels them Awaiting indexing. Embedding and RAG drafting stay separate backend work so the UI does not present stored files as retrievable knowledge.
